theme_and_archetype.description: Premium luxury event planning platform. Focuses on 'Modern Elegance' using generous whitespace, delicate contrast between off-white backgrounds and deep purple accents, and sophisticated serif typography to evoke a sense of exclusivity, trust, and bespoke service.

hierarchy.h1: text-5xl md:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-bold tracking-tight text-[#6B4F8C]

spacing_and_layout.grid_bento: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8 lg:gap-12

components_strategy.navbar: Sticky header with backdrop-blur-xl and bg-[#F8F5F2]/80. Delicate bottom border. Navigation links must use hover:text-[#BFA2DB] transitions.
components_strategy.buttons: Primary CTAs use bg-[#6B4F8C] text-white with hover:bg-[#4F3A6A] hover:shadow-lg hover:-translate-y-1 transition-all duration-300 rounded-full px-8 py-4. Secondary buttons use border-2 border-[#BFA2DB] text-[#6B4F8C] hover:bg-[#BFA2DB] hover:text-white rounded-full px-8 py-4.
components_strategy.cards: For events and packages: bg-white rounded-2xl overflow-hidden shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)] hover:shadow-[0_20px_40px_rgb(107,79,140,0.1)] transition-all duration-500. Images must have overflow-hidden wrapper with hover:scale-105 transition on the img.
components_strategy.badges: Availability/Discount badges: bg-[#BFA2DB] text-white text-xs font-semibold px-4 py-1.5 rounded-full uppercase tracking-wider absolute top-4 right-4 z-10.
components_strategy.forms: Inputs should have bg-transparent, border-b-2 border-[#BFA2DB]/50 focus:border-[#6B4F8C] focus:outline-none focus:ring-0 rounded-none px-0 py-3 text-[#333333] transition-colors placeholder:text-[#666666].
components_strategy.admin_dashboard: Use Shadcn/UI for admin dashboard components (tables, dialogs, forms). Style cards with subtle border and flat colors. Primary admin color #6B4F8C.

motion_and_interactions.libraries: framer-motion for scroll reveals and page transitions.
motion_and_interactions.scroll_reveal: Fade up with y: 40, opacity: 0 to y: 0, opacity: 1 over 0.8s duration.
motion_and_interactions.counters: Use 'framer-motion' animate function for Stats Counter in Hero section (e.g. 500+ Events, 10+ Years).

hero.overlay: bg-black/30 or bg-gradient-to-r from-black/50 to-transparent for text readability

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure global configuration of fonts Playfair Display and Poppins in HTML head and tailwind.config.js.
Do NOT use generic UI elements for the Marketing pages (Home, Gallery, Packages). Use pure HTML/Tailwind with framer-motion. Shadcn is strictly for the Admin Dashboard.
Include 'data-testid' on ALL buttons, inputs, links, forms, and major interactive widgets.
For WhatsApp integration, construct links using 'https://wa.me/{phonenumber}?text={encoded_message}' format.
Never use via.placeholder.com. Use the exact image URLs provided in the media section.
For the masonry gallery, use pure CSS columns (columns-1 md:columns-2 lg:columns-3 gap-4) or a library like react-responsive-masonry.
In the Contact Form, validation is mandatory (use react-hook-form + zod). Include fields: name, phone, email, event type, date, location, budget, message.
Create a Full Stack Admin Dashboard using standard Shadcn primitives to manage Leads, Packages, Images, and Testimonials.
